UTF-8 renderer manual fixture
Open this file in THE with a UTF-8 terminal and move VERIFY/CURSOR across the marked lines.
Invalid UTF-8 is intentionally not included here; byte-invalid cases live in tests/test_textpos.c.

ASCII ruler:
0123456789|0123456789|0123456789|0123456789|0123456789|

Accents and Latin:
cafe café café naïve résumé coöperate Ångström
precomposed: café élève São Tomé
combining: é éx x é ée

CJK width checks:
A漢B 中日韓 A字B 한글 A語B
wide near ruler:
0123456789|0123456789|0123456789|
A漢B漢C漢D漢E漢F漢G漢H漢I漢J

Single-codepoint emoji width checks:
A😀B A🚀B A🧪B A✅B A⭐B
emoji near ruler:
0123456789|0123456789|0123456789|
A😀B🚀C🧪D✅E⭐F😀G🚀H

Mixed line:
plain 😀 café 漢字 é end 🚀 résumé 中

Viewport clipping checks:
Use VERIFY or horizontal scrolling so the first visible cell lands before, on, and inside the wide characters below.
clip-emoji: 0123456789A😀B0123456789C🚀D0123456789
clip-cjk:   0123456789A漢B0123456789C字D0123456789
clip-mixed: 0123456789A😀B漢C é D🚀E0123456789
